styleguide.title: Style guide
styleguide.intro: A preview of Warm Paper Finance on fictional sample data.

overview.heading: Sample overview
overview.insightHeadline: Restaurant spending was {{percent}} lower than in September.
overview.insightEvidence: {{current}} compared with {{previous}}. Full months, excluding own transfers.

typography.heading: Typography
typography.body: Body text: calm, factual and concise. Amounts always use the sans-serif with tabular numerals.

import.intro: Upload a CSV transaction history exported from Moje ING. Overlapping periods are fine: the same transactions are never added twice.
import.hint: An ING Bank Śląski export, up to 5 MB.

failure.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB. Export a shorter period.
failure.unsupportedFormat: The file wasn't recognised. Upload a CSV exported from ING Bank Śląski.
failure.headerNotFound: The file has no ING transaction list. Check that it is a CSV export.
failure.headerMismatch: The columns differ from an ING export. Export the file again, without editing it in a spreadsheet.
failure.unknown: The file couldn't be imported. Please try again.

result.alreadyImported: This file was already imported on {{date}}.

expired.one: {{count}} card hold was missing from the newer statement and is marked as expired.
expired.other: {{count}} card holds were missing from the newer statement and are marked as expired.

totals.passed: The number and sum of transactions match the statement summary.
totals.failed: The number or sum of transactions differs from the statement summary.
totals.notAvailable: The statement has no summary to compare with.

balance.passed: The balances after each transaction add up.
balance.failed: Some balances after transactions don't add up.
balance.notAvailable: The statement has no balances to check.

warnings.periodGap: No data for {{from}}–{{to}}. Upload a statement that covers those days.
warnings.balanceMismatch: Row {{line}} ({{account}}): balance {{actual}}, but the previous transaction gives {{expected}}.

totalsCountMismatch.credits: Credits: the statement says {{expected}}, {{actual}} were read.
totalsCountMismatch.debits: Debits: the statement says {{expected}}, {{actual}} were read.

totalsSumMismatch.credits: Sum of credits: the statement says {{expected}}, {{actual}} was read.
totalsSumMismatch.debits: Sum of debits: the statement says {{expected}}, {{actual}} was read.

warnings.unknownDetailsCode: Unknown transaction type “{{value}}” (from row {{line}}). These transactions have the type “other”.

errors.missingTransactionId: Row {{line}}: a booked transaction without a number.
errors.unknownAccount: Row {{line}}: the account “{{account}}” isn't in the statement's account list.
errors.other: Row {{line}}: the row couldn't be read.
